verdict.rationale: Bevy's docs claim asset hot reload with 'instant feedback on your changes without app restarts or recompiles', but this is limited to scenes, textures, and meshes. Game logic is Rust code, so a logic change still needs a recompile, which the docs put at 0.8-3.0 seconds with the 'fast compiles' configuration. That is a fast loop but not true hot reload of logic. Missing for 10: hot reload of game logic/code without recompiling, independent or hands-on confirmation of the claimed compile times, and documentation of the fast-compiles setup.
